name: Morning Spine Wake-Up
note: Cat-cow into thread-the-needle into low cobra. Five rounds, slow.

name: Hip Opener Sequence
note: Pigeon, lizard, half-frog. Hold longer than feels comfortable.

name: Post-Run Restore
note: Long forward folds, supine twist, legs-up-the-wall.

name: Pre-Sleep Yin
note: Five poses, three minutes each. Lights out within 20 of finishing.

name: Standing Wake-Up (No Mat)
note: Done it on hotel floors and gas-station parking lots. Works.

name: Shoulder Reset
note: Banded pulls, prone Y/T/W, gentle thoracic openers.
